source: Titles and URLs of public Vates / XCP-ng / Xen Orchestra pages returned by web search on 2026-10-10; only the search-result summaries were used, the pages themselves were not read, except the Fohdeesha/xcp-stuff entries (basis "read", seen 2026-10-13) whose pages were fetched and read.

entries.topic: Pool master (coordinator) unreachable / emergency mode

articles.title: High availability (HA) - XCP-ng troubleshooting docs
Pool master down, what steps need done next?
Transfer Pool Master / only partial success
Hosts in a pool have gone offline after reboot
Help: Clean shutdown of Host, now no network or VMs are detected

entries.cause: Per the search summaries: a member cannot reach the pool coordinator; with HA enabled this can be tied to HA behaviour. Community advice: an emergency network reset on the affected host (after a toolstack restart on the master did not help) fixed one case.
resolution: Docs (summary): xe host-emergency-ha-disable force=true then xe-toolstack-restart to start from a stable state with HA off.
If the master is really dead: xe pool-emergency-transition-to-master uuid=<host uuid> on a survivor, then xe pool-emergency-reset-master master-address=<new master> on the other hosts.
Re-enable HA afterwards: xe pool-ha-enable heartbeat-sr-uuid=<sr uuid>.

A dead former master can be removed with xe host-forget uuid=<uuid> (forum answer). Vates guidance quoted in a thread: promote manually if you consider the host dead; HA can do it automatically but is tricky.

entries.topic: HA: unexpected host reboot / self-fence

articles.title: High availability - XCP-ng docs
High availability (HA) - XCP-ng troubleshooting docs
XCP-ng High Availability: a guide
HA causes reboot of xcp-ng nodes
Other 2 hosts reboot when 1 host in HA enabled pool is powered off
Can't Enable High Availability Feature

entries.cause: Per the docs summary: a host that loses both network and storage heartbeat treats itself as problematic and does a hard power-off/restart (default timeout 60 s). Heartbeats are UDP over the management network and a ha-statefile on the heartbeat SR. At least 3 hosts are recommended; with two, loss of the link between them can get hosts fenced.
resolution: Check /var/log/xha.log to see whether the host self-fenced or another host requested the reboot.
A fenced host that cannot reach the heartbeat disk reports it could not join the liveset (docs summary).
One forum report attributes repeated reboots to heartbeat packets routed out of the wrong bonded interface (community analysis, not official).
To investigate stability: xe host-emergency-ha-disable force=true and xe-toolstack-restart (docs summary).

entries.topic: Control domain / log partition full

articles.title: Logs Partition Full
log_fs_usage / /var/log directory on pool master filling up constantly
Disk Usage for Control Domain on server 'abc.mydomain.com' has reached 92%.
Xen Orchestra Update Failed - Error: ENOSPC: no space left on device

entries.cause: Per the summaries: /var/log is a small separate partition and / can fill for reasons other than logs. In one pool-master case SR.scan log spam filled /var/log.
resolution: Find the big files first: du -xh /var/log | sort -h | tail, and df -h.
Pool-master case: lower SR rescan frequency with xe host-param-set other-config:auto-scan-interval=120 uuid=<host uuid>; old XenTools were also suspected in the thread.
One thread traced a full /var/log to XS80E* hotfix entries that should not exist on XCP-ng (a Vates engineer suspected a buggy XCP-Center offering Citrix hotfixes).

entries.topic: xapi / toolstack not responding or not coming back

articles.title: Common Problems - XCP-ng docs
toolstack-reboot and 100% disk usage. Bad idea
xe sr-list Error: Connection refused (calling connect )
Master XCP host stuck - Urgent

entries.cause: Per the summaries: the toolstack restart only affects management services (running VMs untouched) but removes backup/export tasks. A full log partition, a database inconsistency or (in one thread) a certificate entry whose file was deleted can keep xapi from starting.
resolution: Check xe task-list before restarting; check service xapi status and /var/log/daemon.log.
Free disk space; if it still fails a host reboot was the usual last resort in the threads.
Stale certificate case: the poster downgraded xapi, recreated a dummy certificate file so xe pool-certificate-uninstall could remove the DB entry, then upgraded again (single forum report).

entries.topic: Rolling Pool Update / yum update failures

articles.title: Updates - XCP-ng docs
Rolling Pool Update Failed
Rolling Pool Update - failing
Rolling Pool Update - not possible to resume a failed RPU
RPU Failure on 8.3: Yum HTTPS 500 Error for xo-lite package (Hung Task)
yum update, no more free space?

entries.cause: Per the summaries: causes reported include incomplete yum transactions, stale repo metadata, repository mirror HTTP 500 errors, a full root filesystem, scheduled backups/replication running during the RPU, and CANNOT_EVACUATE_HOST when a VM booted on CPU features the target host lacks.
resolution: Clean up incomplete yum transactions / run yum clean all, then update again.
Disable backups during the RPU (community ambassador advice in a thread).
CANNOT_EVACUATE_HOST for CPU features: shut the VM down and boot it again (Vates co-founder suggestion in a thread).
Manual fallback from forum staff: yum update with the xcp-ng-base and xcp-ng-updates repos on each host, migrating VMs away before rebooting each host.
entries.notes: After a failed RPU the pool may report no missing patches on the master while other hosts still need them (forum report).

entries.topic: SR full: coalesce cannot run, snapshots fail

articles.title: Backup troubleshooting - Xen Orchestra docs
Issue with SR and coalesce
Some backups failing
Base Copy / VDI not merged
How to recover free space after delete snapshots

entries.cause: Per the summaries: coalesce runs after a snapshot is deleted and can fail when the SR lacks free space, which then keeps the SR full; the XO docs suggest keeping 30% or more free. A snapshot on thick-provisioned LVM reserves the full disk size. One forum case shows SR_BACKEND_FAILURE_44 (insufficient space) caused by a separate, nearly full SR.
resolution: Free space first: move VMs/disks to another SR (also forces a coalesce) or delete old snapshots keeping the base and the latest.
Rescan the SR to restart coalesce (harmless, not guaranteed).
Shut the VMs down before rescanning for a better chance of offline coalesce (user report).
Vates staff (forum) recommend thin-provisioned storage such as local ext over thick LVM for large disks.

entries.topic: Coalesce / garbage collection stuck

articles.title: SR Garbage Collection running permanently
VDI to coalesce (495)
Snapshot chain too long in NFS SR
Base Copy / VDI not merged
Backup troubleshooting - Xen Orchestra docs

entries.cause: Per the summaries: a VDI to coalesce count that does not fall means coalesce is stuck; repeated UNDO LEAF-COALESCE entries appear in SMlog in one thread; a Vates engineer said the garbage collector cannot run when it cannot edit a corrupted VDI.
resolution: grep for exceptions and coalesce in /var/log/SMlog on the relevant host; ps axf | grep vhd to see a running coalesce.
Rescan the SR to trigger a coalesce.
Migrating the VM disks to another SR forces a coalesce (last resort per XO docs).
A 8.3 leaf-coalesce timeout workaround edits LIVE_LEAF_COALESCE_MAX_SIZE / LIVE_LEAF_COALESCE_TIMEOUT in /opt/xensource/sm/cleanup.py - unofficial forum advice, back up first.
Removing a confirmed-orphaned parent VHD by hand worked once (cleanup then took about 20 h on NFS) - risky, forum report only.

entries.topic: VDI chain too long (SR_BACKEND_FAILURE_109)

articles.title: Error: SR_BACKEND_FAILURE_109(, The snapshot chain is too long, )
unhealthy VDI chain
VDI Chain on Deltas
Delta backup fails for specific vm with VDI chain error
XOA - backups skipped to protect VDI chain
Backup troubleshooting - Xen Orchestra docs

entries.cause: Per the XO docs summary: XCP-ng caps a VHD chain at 30 elements and the error is a protection mechanism; the system should coalesce the chain automatically, so a stuck coalesce is the usual cause.
resolution: Look at the SR Advanced tab in XO for the VDI to coalesce count and at /var/log/SMlog on the host.
Rescan the SR; migrate the disks to another SR as a last resort.

entries.topic: SR / PBD not plugged after reboot (iSCSI, NFS, local)

articles.title: How to Re-attach an SR
Unstable NFS SR mounts
After upgrade to 8.0: iSCSI connection fails after reboot · Issue #260 · xcp-ng/xcp
Host chronically losing local SR
Unable to unmount iscsi SR - SR_BACKEND_FAILURE_1200

entries.cause: Per the summaries: causes in different threads were an iSCSI login/discovery problem (CHAP), a missing /dev/disk/by-scsid device, stale NFS mounts, and corrupted LVM metadata on a local drive. No single fix applies.
resolution: Check xensource.log and SMlog while running xe pbd-plug.
iSCSI: run iscsiadm sendtargets discovery first, check whether iscsid is hung.
NFS: unmount the stale path, reconnect; consider hard (or hard,vers=4) mount options.
NFS server as a VM on the same host: autostart that VM first, then xe pbd-plug (user script).

entries.topic: Not enough free memory to start / migrate / evacuate

articles.title: Not enough server memory when start VM
xcp-ng host RAM
Mysterious failure in HA with HOST_NOT_ENOUGH_FREE_MEMORY · Issue #4323 · xapi-project/xen-api
Unable to MIgrate VDI when host is low on free memory
XCP-ng 8.2 Rolling Update Error

entries.cause: Per the summaries: memory already committed (dynamic-max of all VMs plus dom0), stale state after migrations, and, with HA enabled, evacuation failing with HOST_NOT_ENOUGH_FREE_MEMORY even when memory is free (GitHub issue; advice in a thread: disable HA before a rolling pool update).
resolution: Compare xe host-list params=memory-free with xe vm-compute-maximum-memory for the VM.
Restart the toolstack or reboot the host; switch the VM to static memory.
Disable HA before a rolling pool update.

entries.topic: VM fails to start (bootloader, emulator, power state)

articles.title: Failed to start VM
error no kernel found
The emulator required to run this VM failed to start..?
VM_BAD_POWER_STATE
VM Hang - Can't restart, can't power on.
XCP host rebooted: VM's wont start anymore :-(

entries.cause: Per the summaries: PV-mode guests with a changed bootloader fail with "no kernel/loader found" (PV is no longer supported; convert to HVM and install GRUB); FAILED_TO_START_EMULATOR after a patch update; attached CD/ISO images; missing Secure Boot certificates; a VM on local storage of another host; a full disk. No search result matched HVM_BOOT_FAILED or VM_FAILED_SHUTDOWN_ACKNOWLEDGMENT specifically.
resolution: Read /var/log/xensource.log (and xl dmesg) for the first underlying error.
Restart the toolstack on all hosts or reboot them; try another host.
xe vm-cd-eject --multiple if a stale ISO is attached.

xe vm-reset-powerstate (--force) only when the old host is truly down (XAPI refuses while the host is live); a dead master may first need xe pool-emergency-transition-to-master and xe pool-recover-slaves (thread reports).

entries.topic: Live migration / storage migration failures

articles.title: Live Migration Fails: MIRROR_FAILED
Migrate failed
Live Migrate between two stand alone pools fails
VM Migration Failed & Now Can't Access VM
VM Migrate problem

entries.cause: Per the summaries: a live storage migration fails (MIRROR_FAILED) when the VM writes faster than the block mirror can copy; other causes were a dynamic minimum memory that is too low, no free memory on the target, MCS VMs not supporting storage XenMotion, and a bad power state.
resolution: Check /var/log/xensource.log on the source host.
Large write-heavy VMs: warm migration (Vates CEO suggestion in a thread).
A VM left looking running after a failed migration: xe vm-reset-powerstate or a toolstack restart (threads).

entries.topic: XO backup: VDI_IO_ERROR and remote problems

articles.title: Backup troubleshooting - Xen Orchestra docs
[Backup Ng deltaBackup] VDI_IO_ERROR(Device I/O errors) · Issue #3242 · vatesfr/xen-orchestra
Backup job failed / Remotes issue · Issue #5451 · vatesfr/xen-orchestra
VDI_IO_ERROR(Device I/O errors) when you run scheduled backup

entries.cause: Per the XO docs summary: VDI_IO_ERROR comes from the host (dom0), not XO: the host could not read the VM disk during the HTTP export. Listed causes: a corrupted VDI or a race during snapshots, a too-slow SR, a long job timeout with a slow remote. For NFS remotes a forum thread suggests a hard mount or adjusted soft timeout/retries.
resolution: grep -i error /var/log/SMlog on the host for coalesce or VDI corruption.
Check the job timeout, overlap with other jobs, and the NFS mount options on the XO host/remote.

entries.topic: XO cannot connect to a pool: self-signed / expired certificate

articles.title: Improving security in Xen Orchestra
Troubleshooting - Xen Orchestra docs
SSL certificate verification fails in stats query · Issue #2723 · vatesfr/xen-orchestra

entries.cause: Per the summaries: since a 5.8.x release XO does not connect to a host with an invalid (self-signed or expired) certificate unless that is explicitly allowed in the UI; plain HTTP is possible but unencrypted; the docs describe regenerating an expired appliance certificate with openssl and restarting xo-server.
resolution: Accept the certificate via the warning/toggle in the server settings after verifying it, or install a trusted certificate on every pool host (xe commands exist for host certificates).
Expired appliance cert: back up /etc/ssl cert.pem/key.pem, regenerate with openssl req -x509, restart xo-server (docs summary).

entries.topic: XO from sources: build / node errors

articles.title: Installing XO from source
Errors during build process · Issue #2774 · vatesfr/xen-orchestra
loader.js - Cannot find module · Issue #5782 · vatesfr/xen-orchestra
Build fails with error · Issue #62 · ronivay/XenOrchestraInstallerUpdater

entries.cause: Per the summaries: a node version that does not satisfy the engine requirement, native module compile errors on unsupported node versions, or a regression in a specific commit.

entries.topic: XOA / XO update failures

articles.title: Troubleshooting - Xen Orchestra docs
Updates - Xen Orchestra docs
Update error - Xen Orchestra forum

entries.cause: Per the summaries: transparent proxies breaking the updater with SSL/TLS errors, a corrupted or missing package, missing network access to xen-orchestra.com and nodejs.org on 443, or a missing registration.
resolution: xoa check, then journalctl -u xoa-updater -f -n 50 while reproducing.
Delete /var/lib/xoa-updater/update.json and run xoa-updater --upgrade to force a fresh download.
Proxy workaround from the docs summary (lowers TLS security): NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0 in /etc/xo-appliance/env, restart xoa-updater.

entries.topic: Multipath path failures: kernel message the community health check watches

articles.title: Fohdeesha/xcp-stuff: XCP-ng / XOA health check and repair scripts (README, src/checks.py, src/config.py read)

entries.cause: The health check scans kern.log and the dmesg ring for "device-mapper: multipath: Failing path" and reports timestamped events, because the per-map path_faults counter never resets; it also flags maps with unusable or mismatched path counts across hosts.
resolution: Compare path counts per map across hosts and look for a map with no usable path (multipath -ll).
entries.notes: Third-party community project (GPL-3.0), read on 2026-10-13 (the repo pages themselves, not only a search summary). LogLens has not run or audited these scripts: read and test before use.

entries.topic: Network mount stalls and hung tasks: phrases the community health check watches

articles.title: Fohdeesha/xcp-stuff: XCP-ng / XOA health check and repair scripts (README, src/checks.py, src/config.py read)

entries.cause: It matches the CIFS message "has not responded in", the NFS message "not responding" and the kernel hung-task message "blocked for more than". Its config comment says the hung-task detector stops logging after a set number of warnings and did not fire at all on the host the check was built on, so absence of the message proves nothing.
resolution: Probe each network mount with a stat (it times out after 10 s in that tool) and look for processes stuck in uninterruptible sleep.

entries.topic: Tapdisk death, I/O errors and SM log phrases the community tools look for

articles.title: Fohdeesha/xcp-stuff: XCP-ng / XOA health check and repair scripts (README, src/checks.py, src/config.py read)

entries.cause: Its log scanner reports, per phrase, "Input/output error", "XENAPI_PLUGIN_FAILURE", "TapdiskNotRunning" and Python exceptions in SMlog and xensource.log (each with the .1 rotation, since rotation around 04:00 leaves the live file nearly empty in the morning). The config comment says TapdiskNotRunning means tapdisk died and pairs with a core.tapdisk.* dump.
resolution: Scan the rotated .1 file as well as the live file in the morning.

entries.topic: Leaked / stuck storage datapaths: what storage-state-fixer.py detects and why it matters

articles.title: Fohdeesha/xcp-stuff: XCP-ng / XOA health check and repair scripts (README, src/checks.py, src/config.py read)

entries.cause: Per the README: dead dom0 datapaths, stale dom0 VBDs, leaked datapaths with paused or wedged tapdisks and stuck GC flags make exports, backups or VBD unplugs fail. Per the script (read in part): with other datapaths still present xapi would have to make a state change it refuses (Illegal_transition), the VDI is marked leaked and every later attach on that host fails; it matches SMlog phrases such as "not detached cleanly", "is still open on host", "Failed to lock ... blocked by PID" and "tap.deactivate: Warning, No such Tapdisk".
resolution: The tool (XCP-ng 8.3 only) runs as root on the pool master, reports what it found, and applies changes only after you type yes. Editing storage.db restarts xapi on that host; VMs keep running but HA is turned off and on around the restart. Download it instead of piping from curl; backups go to storage-state-fixer-data/.
entries.notes: Third-party community project (GPL-3.0), read on 2026-10-13 (the repo pages themselves, not only a search summary). LogLens has not run or audited these scripts: read and test before use. Do not run it blind: it changes storage.db.

entries.topic: Snapshot-link repair: community script for broken snapshot_of records (related, no log signature)

articles.title: Fohdeesha/xcp-stuff: XCP-ng / XOA health check and repair scripts (README, src/checks.py, src/config.py read)

entries.cause: Per the README: snapshot-fixer.py (XCP-ng 8.2 and 8.3) repairs incongruent snapshot links in the xapi database - a VM or VDI that is not a snapshot but has snapshot_of set, or a VDI recorded as a snapshot of itself. The README names no error string, so this is only related to snapshot/backup trouble, not a log match.
resolution: dry-run shows the proposed changes; rewrite stops xapi, backs up the database, fixes it and restarts xapi (with HA handled); restore-backup restores the backup. Download it, run dry-run first.
entries.notes: Third-party community project (GPL-3.0), read on 2026-10-13 (the repo pages themselves, not only a search summary). LogLens has not run or audited these scripts: read and test before use. Only relevant if xapi really holds such records.

entries.topic: Xen Orchestra config export when the UI is dead after a failed update (community script)

articles.title: Fohdeesha/xcp-stuff: XCP-ng / XOA health check and repair scripts (README, src/checks.py, src/config.py read)

entries.cause: Per the README: xo-config-recover.py exports the XO configuration (the same file as Settings > Config > Export) from XOA without a working xo-server, reading Redis (or the last dump.rdb); it does not modify anything; the output contains every pool root password; encrypted credential databases are not supported.
resolution: Run as root on XOA (python3 <(curl ...) in the README); --check shows what would be exported without writing; --passphrase-file encrypts the output.
entries.notes: Third-party community project (GPL-3.0), read on 2026-10-13 (the repo pages themselves, not only a search summary). LogLens has not run or audited these scripts: read and test before use. Treat the output as a secret.
